blind.description: A rectangular stylized stone altar or sarcophagus featuring a thick beveled slab top with engraved cracks and seams. The body has carved miniature classical columns framing an arched central relief with a sun emblem on the front, flanked by recessed side panels. It rests on an integrated stepped stone base that sits flat on the ground. The texture is a weathered, hand-painted greenish-grey stone with subtle edge highlights.
blind.from_above: A flat, beveled rectangular stone slab with visible carved joints and fine surface cracks, greenish-grey in color.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2.5 to 3 feet tall (waist height on the 5 ft 9 in figure), about 5 feet long, and about 2.5 feet wide.
